name: skills
description: A collection of Claude Code plugins: LLM Wiki knowledge base tools and reimpl-tutorial for deep codebase understanding

plugins.name: wiki-tools
plugins.description: Query, update, and ingest knowledge into a personal LLM Wiki. Provides /wiki-query, /wiki-update, /wiki-ingest skills globally.

plugins.name: reimpl-tutorial
plugins.description: Generate 'from zero to expert' tutorials by reimplementing projects in Jupyter notebooks. Includes excalidraw-diagram skill for SVG diagram generation.

plugins.name: zentao
plugins.description: Manage 禅道 (ZenTao) open-source PMS via its REST v1 API. Full read/write across products, projects, executions, stories, tasks, bugs, todos, users.

plugins.name: ide-maintain
plugins.description: 墨斗 IDE 维护辅助。进入以下 10 个 IDE 关联仓库任一（opemindstudio / devicemanager / inktank-occ-master / inktank-node-occ / inktank-kdl / robot-workstation / inktank-core / three-editor / inktank-master / inktank-platform）或智能焊接任务（E:\分析\智能焊接\）时自动加载 project_wiki 相关条目，会话期间维护新发现知识清单，任务完成提示同步回 wiki。提供 /ide-context-load、/ide-knowledge-track、/ide-wiki-sync 三个 skills。

plugins.name: task-decompose
plugins.description: Theory-grounded task decomposition methodology: split a project into parallel work-lines, map requirements to lines (many-to-many via DMM), insert stubs to decouple cross-line dependencies (DSM tearing), identify the true constraint (TOC, usually headcount), and assign integration owners. Grounded in DSM/MDM, WBS, Parnas, Conway's Law, Team Topologies. Living skill, updated as projects surface new patterns.
